debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (RSI overbought + stoch bullish cross) with fresh breakouts above DC10/DC20 provides tactical entry near support (294.37) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), long-term trend weakness (EMA 50/200 bearish), overbought conditions limiting upside, zero fundamental support, and 41-day earnings risk create asymmetric downside exposure that outweighs short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: While ACN shows strong short-term momentum (RSI overbought + stoch bullish cross) with price at support (294.37), the severe macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels) and complete absence of fundamental conviction (zero smart money, no insider buying, 41-day earnings risk) create asymmetric downside that outweighs tactical technicals.
